dataList.content:
<color=#E1B643>So nice to meet you, Dante.</color>
<color=#E1B643>很高兴见到你，但丁。</color>
dataList.place:
Le Rouge Handbags Hall, 4F
4F 红派箱包馆

dataList.content:
<color=#E1B643>This is the first time we've met each other so up close, isn't it?</color>
<color=#E1B643>我们还是第一次这么近距离见面吧？</color>

Unlike the faint murmur I've heard before, the same voice now tickled and warmed my proverbial ear with the clarity of someone whispering right into it. At the same time, it felt as though the voice were speaking from an impossibly far-away place, every word echoing just for me.
和之前那若隐若现的感觉不同，那声音虽然像是从远处传来……却如同在耳边低声细语一般，鲜明而温暖地传入耳中。

As though I've finally been made to discover the resonance... that had been calling out to me for so, so long. Yes, that's how it felt...
仿佛如今才发现……许久以前就对我低语的那声响……

... Manager.
……经理。

Please step back. Do not answer the voice.
请不要回应，往后退。

Prolonged exposure... to the sunshine... is inadvisable...
让阳光……长时间照射……并不是好事……

Meursault's warning was firm and crystal clear—despite that, I found myself unable to take so much as a single step away from the wall.
即使默尔索做出了严厉的警告……我却没能后退。

And I wasn't the only one. Hong Lu and Don Quixote stood rooted in their spots as though something pinned them to the ground—in fact, it appeared that they could not move a single muscle or even move to cover their ears and block out the voice.
不仅是我，鸿璐……堂吉诃德……都像是两腿被钉住一样……既不能移动，也无法捂住耳朵。

<color=#E1B643>Meur... I can see you're not happy to hear from me, as always.</color>
<color=#E1B643>默尔……不管是以前还是现在，你都不欢迎我呢。</color>

<color=#E1B643>But you know... maybe you shouldn't let your personal distaste for me
dictate whether I should or shouldn't chat with your friends.
Isn't that the sort of judgmental behavior about right and wrong that you so dislike?</color>
<color=#E1B643>不过……只因为你不喜欢……就让同伴们也远离我……这不也是你讨厌的，掺杂了太多是非判断的行动吗？</color>

Surrounded by the silence of the living room, I sat absentmindedly in a patch of sunlight peering through a gap in the windowsill.
我在寂静的客厅里坐了一会，呆望着窗缝间涌入的阳光。
dataList.place:
A Living Room, Past
过去，某间客厅

dataList.content:
The vacuum of what was once there. The warm chill circulating the air. The sun.
变得空荡的地方。飘浮在空中的温暖冷意。太阳。

Then... suddenly, warm sunshine filled my vision, as though I had opened my eyes in a park at midday.
正在那时，我忽然……如同在正午公园睁开双眼那样，感受到眼前充盈了温暖的阳光。

It was so boundlessly bright... that I raised my hand to shield my eyes.
那无限明亮的色彩……让我不禁抬手遮住双眼。

... It's blinding.
……真刺眼。

<color=#E1B643>If my light dazzles you, it's only because you've been in the dark for so long.</color>
<color=#E1B643>之所以会觉得我的光刺眼，是因为你长久以来都身在黑暗中吧。</color>

<color=#E1B643>.......</color>
<color=#E1B643>……</color>

<color=#E1B643>I like to think I've spoken with my fair share of buttoned-up people, Meursault...
... but you've got to be the most taciturn out of them all.</color>
<color=#E1B643>我虽然确实和很多寡言少语的人聊过天，但默尔索，你在那些人之中也尤为沉默呢。</color>

<color=#E1B643>It must've been so suffocating.
Tens of thousands of thoughts howling under that quiet, taciturn demeanor...
... and no one stopped to listen, did they? 

Even if they had, I don't suppose they would have understood how the world reflects in your eyes.</color>
<color=#E1B643>你一定很烦闷吧。即使你沉默着思考了成千上万的事……人们也不会加以倾听。
即使听过了你看待世界的方式，想必他们也无法理解吧。</color>

The curtain of sunshine talked to me in a beautiful voice. Bright. Uplifting.
从阳光中听到的那声音……既明快，又美丽。

It sympathized with the things in my mind that no one understood. It laid bare the thoughts that I had never shown another soul.
能理解不曾被理解的想法，揭露不曾展示给他人的思想。

I knew I must not answer the voice... yet my lips quivered against my will.
哪怕清楚不能去回答这道声音……嘴唇却不由得颤动。

<color=#E1B643>I see. You've chosen to cover your ears and squeeze your eyes shut.</color>
<color=#E1B643>你捂上了耳朵，还紧紧闭上了双眼啊。</color>

<color=#E1B643>But Meursault...
If it could be unheard by covering your ears, if it could be unseen by closing your eyes...
... then that was probably never the sunlight to begin with.</color>
<color=#E1B643>可默尔索……如果捂上耳朵就听不见，闭上眼睛就看不见……那……根本就不是阳光了呀。</color>

<color=#E1B643>You see, the light that my favorite junior worked so hard to fire up into the sky, to plant...
... shines down everywhere, on everyone. It doesn't discriminate.</color>
<color=#E1B643>我珍贵的后辈竭力向上升起后播种下的光……会平等地洒向任何角落呢。</color>

<color=#E1B643>All I want is to offer you a choice.
You can always say no if you don't like what you hear.</color>
<color=#E1B643>我只是提出建议而已。不合心意的话，拒绝就好啦。</color>

Air leaks from my lungs in uncontrolled bursts of gasps—ecstatic, joyful, thrilled, hoping. With every breath I take, the warm, feel-good emotions enter my nose and pool in the back of my throat.
肺中……擅自渗出了气息。欢喜、喜悦、期待、期望。这些无比温暖的感情，不断随着呼吸涌入喉管。

Somewhere in my heart, I count to 10, trying to contain them. Then, in my head, 20. I imagine ranks upon ranks of absurdities. Nothing works. My vocal cords, heated to the roots by the inescapable sunlight, start to tingle excitedly.
为了忍受，我在心中数到十，在脑中数到二十，想象着排成队列的众多不合理。然而却无济于事，被阳光烧灼的声带震动起来。

... What...
……是什么。

... What do you offer?
我想问问，你的建议是什么。

<color=#E1B643>Can you imagine what it'd be like... to be peeled away from this terrifying world? All by yourself.</color>
<color=#E1B643>如果从这可怖的世界中……只将你一人抽离出去，怎么样？</color>

<color=#E1B643>What if you no longer had to wrap those chains around yourself... no longer be nailed beneath anyone's gaze, no longer captured by others or bound by "common sense"?</color>
<color=#E1B643>如果能不再被那条锁链重重捆缚……不再被任何视线钉住，不再被任何他人俘获，不再被任何常识束缚……</color>

I am undressed, naked in the light. The sunshine reveals all secrets, and it whispers to me the one thing that I've truly wanted.
一切都被褪去，不容许一丝秘密的阳光正低语着我真正的期望。
No more minding the gaze of others. No more minding the thoughts of others. You could simply be yourself... live as yourself. 无需窥探他人脸色，无需在意他人想法……只需要成为你自己，活成自己的模样就好。

That is... impossible.
那是……不可能的。

<color=#E1B643>You're right. The City has never allowed such a thing.</color>
<color=#E1B643>没错。都市里绝对不会允许这种事。</color>

<color=#E1B643>You couldn't possibly have known how. Couldn't find the path.
To you, the world remained foreign; however many times you struck against it,
its only response was silence... rendering you mute.</color>
<color=#E1B643>既不知道方法，也不清楚去路……世界不过是陌生之物，即使碰撞也毫无反应……你一定无法发出任何声音吧。</color>
But a new era has come, bearing this sunlight. A new age where you can howl as loudly as you wish, and... people will listen. 可如今……尽情叫喊也能得到回应的好时代已经到来。和这……阳光一同。

<color=#E1B643>Let me help you. 
Even if yours is a color no other person can understand,
even if that color remains only in your eyes... 
I'll still help you paint the world with it.</color>
<color=#E1B643>我会帮你。即便没人理解，即便是仅属于你的色彩……也能让你涂抹这世界……</color>

... Did you make the same offer to my mother?
……你对妈妈也提过一样的建议吗。

<color=#E1B643>Similar, maybe... but not the same.
People like to think they understand one another, think they're kindred spirits...
But in the end, they understand nothing about others—they can't.
We're all our own beings, after all.</color>
<color=#E1B643>不太一样吧。虽然大差不差。人们总以为能互相理解，以为彼此属于同类……
结果却是无法理解任何一点。毕竟我们都是不同的人啊。</color>

The cheerful voice seemed to scratch an itch buried deep in my heart, somewhere no hand could ever reach.
明快的声音仿佛在抓挠心脏深处，无法伸手触及的痒处。
You can get your wish. And that begins by being honest about the feelings bubbling inside you right this moment. 为此……首先还是需要你率直地说出如今的感情呢。

<color=#E1B643>It's all right, Meur. You're allowed to give voice... to that emotion.</color>
<color=#E1B643>默尔，把你现在浮上心头的感情……说出口也可以的。</color>

The sunshine...
阳光……

<color=#E1B643>.......</color>
<color=#E1B643>……</color>

... is chattier than I expected.
比想象中要吵闹啊。

Irritatingly so.
甚至让人感到恼怒。

I tried to make my discomfort as evident as possible in my reply...
对这饱含不悦的回应……

... But still there was a hint of laughter in the sunshine, full of cheer.
阳光像是感到愉快似的，充满了笑意。

<color=#E1B643>I don't turn my back on anyone.
Besides... the children in this department store need sunlight.
They need warm, gentle sunlight to shine on them.</color>
<color=#E1B643>我不会背向任何人。而且……这家百货店的孩子们需要阳光。温暖洒下的阳光。</color>

<color=#E1B643>These children... they derive their existence from the fact that someone is gazing at them.
That is their wish, and I simply intend to grant it.</color>
<color=#E1B643>这些孩子……唯有在被谁注视的事实中才能感受到自身的存在。我不过是想要将那份愿望全数实现而已。</color>

<color=#E1B643>Imagine it, Meursault.
Imagine these stuffy ceilings and walls falling away to reveal the world outside.
Everyone gets to rest together in a warm patch of sunshine, taking in the vast sky above.</color>
<color=#E1B643>想象一下，这家百货店令人窒息的顶棚与墙壁崩塌……在向阳处，大家一边晒着太阳，一边仰望天空的场景。</color>

<color=#E1B643>Still so quiet. You haven't changed at all since then.</color>
<color=#E1B643>你还是这么沉默呢。和那时候比起来真是一点没变。</color>

<color=#E1B643>Dante, I suppose you'll have to work a little harder as their Manager.</color>
<color=#E1B643>但丁，作为执行经理的你可要更努力一些啦。</color>
Manager. Do not respond. 经理，不要回应。

<S-sorry, I don't know why I did...>
<对、对不起。下意识就……>

<color=#E1B643>As for Meursault... He may change yet... by the end of this round of the journey at your side.</color>
<color=#E1B643>默尔索也一样……在这次与你同行的旅程结束后，也会有所改变吧。</color>

<color=#E1B643>I'm looking forward to it.</color>
<color=#E1B643>我很期待哦。</color>
